x is a negative real number.

Quantity A: x to the fourth power

Quantity B: x to the third power
instructionsMd: Compare the two quantities using only the given information.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The relationship cannot be determined from the information given.

explanationMd: An even power of a nonzero negative number is positive, while an odd power is negative. Thus the fourth power exceeds the third regardless of magnitude.
